reasons.correctness: Port, adapter, properties and service match the interface exactly. Adapter matches case-insensitively, PLN returns 1, service rounds to 2 decimals HALF_UP, and the exception carries the key and ISO argument. Acceptance 5/5, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort sits in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. Injection is by explicit constructor. BusinessRuleTranslatableException key is added to messages_en and messages_pl. The agent read VatRegistryPort and its adapter before writing. Both new classes are *UnitTest with MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: CurrencyConversionService depends only on ExchangeRatePort, so the rate source can be swapped. Rates are bound through @ConfigurationProperties and defaults live in application.yml. Footprint is small and cohesive, with no duplicated lookup and no parallel mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: Adapter tests cover configured rate, case-insensitivity, PLN=1 and an unknown code. Service tests cover conversion and the missing-rate exception key and args. The rounding test (10×3.955=39.550) never exercises a HALF_UP boundary, and null isoCode is untested.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the existing *Port/*Adapter files and led the agent to VatRegistryPort. After that, navigation relied on find, cat and grep over directories, properties classes and test folders.
